text:
oliver: heads up — proposal: introduce a lightweight "score-broker" between api-gateway and reranker to normalize scoring envelope and compute fanout costs.
lina: can you sketch what the envelope looks like? we already have score, model_id, meta.
mike: idea: add a `weight` float and `encoding` enum. weight ~ relative compute units per candidate. encoding opts: compact, full, signed.
anuj: weight makes sense for quota math. product asks: will this change customer-visible billing? we need to avoid surprise invoice spikes.
oliver: not immediate billing change. weight used for routing + soft quota gating; billing follow-up after we simulate across 2 weeks of telemetry.
lina: implementation note — broker will do pre-fanout budgeting: sum(weights)*candidates <= budget and trim candidates accordingly.
mike: important: backward compat — if client sends legacy envelope, broker interprets missing `weight` as 1.0.
lina: also propose an optional `model_affinity` tag so broker routes heavy candidates to preferred model variants to reduce compute.
anuj: console needs a control: per-route max_fanout and per-route cost_estimate toggle. Ops want an override for emergency fallbacks.
console-bot: deploy plan stub: canary 1% route-wide -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, with auto-roll-back on error-rate or latency spike.
oliver: telemetry: emit `broker.fanout.requested`, `broker.fanout.actual`, `broker.weight.sum`, with p50/p95 latencies and per-model histograms.
mike: sampling: we should keep 100% counters but sample raw payloads at 0.1% for size; histograms aggregated per-tenant.
lina: dashboard UX: add a per-route tile showing estimated compute units / minute, and a small "show impact" modal to simulate raising weight or max_fanout.
anuj: can we show predicted cost delta before toggling? product wants an estimate using recent 7d traffic and model-cost-per-weight heuristics.
oliver: yes. broker exposes an endpoint `/estimate_fanout_cost` used by console. it returns a simple JSON with strings: "estimate":"345 tokens-equivalent" — (we'll keep internal units opaque initially).
mike: caution: avoid leaking model internal perf numbers. estimate should be approximate and capped.
lina: security: RBAC on console controls and audit log for any manual overrides.
anuj: next steps: spike PR in eng-platform to add broker shim + proto changes, then runtime team to implement weight-aware routing. timeline 3 sprints for canary.
oliver: OK — i'll open the RFC doc and tag owners. any objections?
mike: none from runtime side. i'll start proto draft.
lina: will add console mockups and UX flows.
anuj: i'll draft the billing caveats and comms for customers. :thumbsup
_comment: Slack thread about scoring envelope, broker, weighting, fanout controls, telemetry and console UX.
